requirements.title: Execute Barometer App at 20 Hz
requirements.description: The baro app shall execute at 20 Hz on the static schedule throughout the mission.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-008; system-mandated 20 Hz altimeter sample rate is realized by scheduling the baro app at 20 Hz.

requirements.title: Acquire One Sample Each Cycle
requirements.description: The baro app shall acquire one barometer sample on each scheduled execution.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-008; per-cycle sample acquisition realizes the 20 Hz altimeter sample cadence.

requirements.title: Publish Barometer Message on Software Bus
requirements.description: The baro app shall publish a barometer message on the software bus on each scheduled execution.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-001; raw baro samples reach the logging path via a software bus message published by the baro app.

requirements.title: Pure Pass-Through Without Filtering
requirements.description: The baro app shall publish baro samples without applying filtering or modifying their numerical values.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-001; raw fidelity requires the app to forward unmodified baro samples to subscribers.

requirements.title: Timestamp Each Published Baro Message
requirements.description: The baro app shall include a monotonic microsecond timestamp on each published barometer message.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-001; per-sample timestamps with the canonical time base support post-flight reconstruction.

requirements.title: Publish Baro Health on Software Bus
requirements.description: The baro app shall publish barometer health status on the software bus on each scheduled execution.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-031; continuous per-sensor health bitmap requires the app to publish baro health each cycle.

requirements.title: Report Altitude Referenced to WGS-84 Ellipsoid
requirements.description: The baro app shall report altitude in the published baro message referenced to the WGS-84 ellipsoid.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-039; system-wide HAE altitude reference applies to the baro app's published altitude.

requirements.title: Publish Baro Quantities in SI Units
requirements.description: The baro app shall publish pressure in pascals and altitude in meters in the baro message.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-042; SI units globally apply to the baro app's published physical quantities.

requirements.title: POSIX Build Functional Equivalence
requirements.description: The baro app POSIX build shall produce baro messages functionally equivalent to the Pico2 flight build.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-043; system-wide POSIX/Pico2 functional equivalence applies to the baro app's published baro messages so Trick simulation exercises the same software paths as flight.

requirements.title: Deterministic Baro Message Output
requirements.description: The baro app shall produce identical published baro messages given identical inputs.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-044; system-wide deterministic output requirement applies to the baro app for repeatable Trick sim runs and regression analysis.
